architectureDecision.decision: Retain the current canonical subdomains and strengthen useful navigation. Do not create duplicate article copies on the root domain.
architectureDecision.reason: Google does not prescribe subdirectories over subdomains. A migration changes indexed URLs, origin-specific browser storage, asset paths and deployment ownership; no measured benefit currently justifies those changes.
ifMigrationIsLaterChosen: Inventory every indexable URL and stored project origin.
Map each old URL to exactly one new URL and retain language, query and chapter behavior.
Rebase assets and internal links; verify map imports, exports and saved projects.
Update canonical, hreflang and sitemaps together; permanently redirect old URLs.
Compare Search Console indexing, queries and actual tool usage before and after migration.
